title: Unit Event — That day, the Sky was Far Away — Episode1 Accepting the "Present"

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away
meta.Event Outline: Shiho feels a great sense of fulfillment after Leo/need successfully reaches its ticket quota and performs in perfect sync for the audience. She recalls the time she spent on her own back in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Mic check's done!
We should be all good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(There's a nice buzz in the air too.
You can always feel the anticipation building during moments like these.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They should as long as they didn't get lost somewhere along the way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see them...!
There! Towards the middle!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, there's Haruka! Everyone else too!
I'm glad they all managed to find this place!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's Minori and Kohane... Shiraishi too. I guess they all came together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't believe we're really at the live house where Shii and her friends perform! I'm so glad we made it in time too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same...
Looks like leaving early just in case was a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku's here too along with everybody else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's the case, we should be able to give them a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were able to reach our ticket quota because we all worked together, which was a huge relief...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thanks for helping out with that Ichika, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You don't have to thank us!
We're going pro together, right? This is the least we could do!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Selling tickets on top of writing our own songs... We have a lot on our plate, but that's all the more reason for us to work together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's show everyone just how much we appreciate them by giving them a good performance today.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Leo/need, get ready to take the stage!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I think it's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
I finally get to see Shiho's band perform live!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm really glad for you.
It's sort of been a shame that you couldn't see them sooner because of our streams.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure a lot of you here today will be hearing us for the first time, but we hope to give you the best performance we can!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This is awesome!
There's really nothing like a live concert!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Alright, we're in good shape.
The crowd's getting into it more than usual. And...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're playing like we really mean it today. This might be the most fun I've seen them have so far...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright, let's throw in one of these...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wooow...!
Did you see what Shiho just did?! That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was.
And I can feel their music resonating throughout my body...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More. I want to play some more.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (On top of having an audience to play for, we're all chasing after the same dream...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My old self might not even recognize me right now...)

Ugh...
We shouldn't have invited you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I couldn't see myself playing in another band, let alone with these three...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey...!
Is it just me or did we sound a little different today...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, I felt that too...!
It's like we really gave it everything we had...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean, Ichi, Hona!
We played sooo unbelievably well!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We really did. Our individual sounds melded together for each song... It was an incredible feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, can we keep playing?!
Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Hey, the next band needs to get set up! Mind moving your instruments for us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
We'll do that right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, once we've put everything away, we'll join the crowd and see what we can learn from the other bands.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho!
Why'd you run off like that? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you see someone you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I thought I did...
But I might've just gotten their faces mixed up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Reminiscing about what happened back then might've made me see what I wanted to see.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
We should get back before the next band gets started.
